release.authority: ARCHITECTURE.md versioning policy as amended 2026-10-14 (c1daf3e) and confirmed by the maintainer on 2026-10-20 (issue #141). The policy grants the agent any semver level without per-release approval, conditioned on acceptance on the delivered artifact. Deleting, unpublishing or otherwise withdrawing a tag or release, and changing the policy, remain reserved and were not exercised.
release.build_id_ordering: server/build-id.generated.js and dist/client/.build-id both record 4cad4b6, the source revision. The committed assets were built at that source in c456385. f0262ae is a release-metadata commit (version and install references, no source changes) after the assets commit; the tag points there. This follows the v0.4.0 precedent of a release commit with no source changes, though ARCHITECTURE.md's 'assets-only commit' sentence is read as 'a release commit, never a source change'. The tag was not moved after publication.

acceptance_before_tagging.detail: 13 of 13 findings compliant; clean working tree at c456385

acceptance_before_tagging.check: GitHub Actions / Test and type check

acceptance_on_the_delivered_artifact.installed_into: an empty directory, no source checkout present
acceptance_on_the_delivered_artifact.detail: 7 of 7: the reconciliation badge clears WCAG AA in the served stylesheet; a rendered reconciliation badge is styled when live data has one (conditional and passed on this repository); text fields carry a fill distinct from the panel; the Tetris stats panel is opaque; the crossfade is cut under prefers-reduced-motion; the bundle serves the assets the build recorded; and the new gallery check opens ?app=tetris, names Tetris current in the palette, and closes the palette with Escape without unmounting the app.

what_this_release_delivers: #165 canvas content gallery - first-party CanvasApp registry, quiet home gallery row, header Canvas trigger and Ctrl/Cmd+K palette (with ~ alias), focus trap and restore
#165 addressable apps - ?app=tetris; ?app=tetris&panel=7 composes the Requests overlay; browser back/forward replay both
#165 Requests reachability from an app - the header gains a Requests trigger, and opening the palette over Requests closes the panel first
#165 local-state boundary - leaving an app unmounts it; opening and closing the palette alone does not; no new server, API or GitHub surface
Tetris from request #4 is the first gallery entry; its behavior and controls are unchanged
carried_known_gaps: Contextual feedback capture from inside a canvas app is the next slice; this release is navigation only.
The palette is navigation-only and has no command surface.

12 of 75 visual captures differ back-to-back because motion frames are captured with the animation live; 3 more differ at glyph rasterization, 648 of 1,152,000 px. Characterised in #145, not fixed. The determinism guard checks content, not pixels, by design.
The first-login path (gh auth login --web) is unverified live, because verifying it would mean revoking the working session.
limits: Acceptance on the delivered artifact is seven targeted read-only checks. The 264 unit tests and 84 stubbed e2e tests ran against the source revision, not the installed artifact.
The gallery acceptance check exercises shell navigation, the palette and Escape precedence. It does not replay the full game or every gallery e2e case against the installed artifact.

The tag points at f0262ae, a release-metadata commit after the assets commit c456385, not at the assets commit itself. Both build-ID files still record the source 4cad4b6, and the tag was not moved after publication.
'a rendered reconciliation badge, when the data has one' is conditional on live repository state; it passed on this repository but remains conditional by design.
The minor judgement is the agent's under the standing policy: the release adds a new navigation surface and addressable app locations, which read as capability rather than repair.
